text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Error rate 78% over the last 3m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/ops/embeds-eu-west (alert id: A-2026-350112)

marta_oncall: on it. paging @tom_h and @becca_sre. ETA to ack 1m.

tom_h: ack. pulling routing table + recent release anchors.

becca_sre: acked. can someone confirm whether this is a model runtime error or a routing/fallback loop?

tom_h: quick signal: requests to embeddings interface are being routed to a model variant tagged "release-anchor:2026-03-14-v3-chat" for eu-west-1 due to a temporal release anchor that was scheduled yesterday. chat variant doesn't implement the embed path so fallback is attempting chat runtime -> returns 500/invalid-response. logs show "incompatible-io: missing-embed-handler"

jon_ops: that sounds like a pinned/anchor mismatch. can we short-circuit routing to a safe variant while we investigate?

marta_oncall: @tom_h can you show the policy patch that introduced the anchor? who deployed it?

tom_h: looking. commit: git:release/anchors@f7c9ea by devex/lia_devex during a staged rollout. policy excerpt:

```
- matcher: interface == "embeddings" && region == "eu-west-1"
  anchor: release-2026-03-14-v3-chat
  fallbacks:
    - region-fallback: global
    - variant-fallback: nearest-compatible
```

This anchor binds embeddings to a chat-first variant. nearest-compatible resolution prefers same-model family (chat) which has no embed handler -> hot fallback loop.

becca_sre: nice find. that explains the 5xx spike. mitigation options: 1) revert anchor 2) add override mapping embeddings->embed-compatible variant alias 3) pause rollout for region. fastest is 2.

lia_devex: fwiw the rollout was only staged for eu-west after quick perf checks. I didn't test embeddings path — my bad. happy to help roll back.

tom_h: proposing immediate routing override via the router admin API (no code deploy). command:

```
curl -X POST https://router.admin/api/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"matcher":"interface==\"embeddings\" && region==\"eu-west-1\"","target":"model:embed-v2-compat","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```

becca_sre: if we apply that, monitor error rate and traces for 30s then remove. I'll stand by to revert if needed.

jon_ops: also flip on an emergency rule to route new sessions to global pool to reduce blast radius: `--route-priority=global`

marta_oncall: @lia_devex can you apply the override? please paste the execution output here.

lia_devex: running now.

lia_devex: executed override, response: 200 OK, override_id=o-9b3f. applying to router cluster eu-west-1 nodes.

incident-bot: routing-override-applied override_id=o-9b3f by lia_devex at 3501122870

becca_sre: monitoring traces -> error rate dropping to 12% in last 30s. token success counts starting to return. good sign.

tom_h: digging into traces: requests that previously hit chat runtime show stack: Router -> VariantResolver -> ChatRuntime -> error(incompatible-io). After override they route to EmbedRuntime v2 and succeed.

amy_cs: customer-impact question: which customers/teams hit this? any paid customers affected?

jon_ops: initial check: ~14 production orgs had >5% of their embeddings traffic routed in eu-west. two early-stage customers saw embed API 500s in their dashboards and opened support tickets.

amy_cs: drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating elevated errors for embeddings in eu-west. We've applied a routing override to mitigate. We will provide a follow-up with root cause and timeline." will post to status.redwood.ai when we have confirmation.

lia_devex: quick note: the anchor was created to stabilize latency for a gen-heavy release; we missed interface-level compatibility check. adding to postmortem.

marta_oncall: next steps: 1) keep override for 1h while we run regression tests 2) roll back the anchor in next safe window if tests fail 3) create automated check that anchors flagged for interface "embeddings" must have embed handler

tom_h: running integration smoke for embeds against the staged release now. logs:

```
[smoke-test] POST /v1/embeddings -> 200, latency p95=120ms
[smoke-test] sample-embed: OK
```

becca_sre: tests look green on a single node but we need cluster-wide verification; lia, can you schedule the staged release hold to be canceled? or revert anchor now?

lia_devex: prefer hold rather than revert until we can patch policy generator. pausing further anchor rollouts: runbook executed.

incident-bot: hold-on-rollout executed for release-2026-03-14 by lia_devex at 3501123025

jon_ops: support tickets: CS ticket #7781 and #7783. we should send an interim message to them. amy, can you coordinate?

amy_cs: drafting now, will post to tickets and status. note: impact window ~3501122200-3501122900 UTC, error spike start ~3501122247.

marta_oncall: update: error rate down to 3% in last 5m. CPU and GPU metrics normal. looks mitigated.

becca_sre: reassigning for postmortem: owner = lia_devex, secondary = tom_h. add automated integration gate to release anchor deploy pipeline.

lia_devex: ack. I'll own the postmortem and schedule a blameless RCA. will also add the interface-compat check to the release DSL.

tom_h: logs/grep for the failing request snippet for debugging:

```
[router] req=0x9f3a path=/v1/embeddings headers={X-Model-Tag: release-2026-03-14-v3-chat}
[chat-runtime] ERROR incompatible-io: embed-handler-missing
```

marta_oncall: final check: any lingering 5xxs from eu-west? ops dashboard shows short tail, <1%.

amy_cs: status post to customers prepared. will send in 5m once we confirm no regression.

incident-bot: incident A-2026-350112 status=resolved-mitigated at 3501123456. mitigation: routing override applied; staged rollout paused. assigned to lia_devex for remediation and postmortem.

marta_oncall: great work team. follow-up: lia, please include a timeline and the policy patch in the PM. we'll schedule a quick retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
